steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Talk to the mercenary adventurer east of Paterdomus in Morytania.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

steps.text: Continue talking to the Mercenary Adventurer.

actions.text: Who do you think these suspicious people are?

steps.text: Climb down the stairway to the west.
Search the sparkling wall storage unit.
Climb the ladder to the west.

actions.text: Do you think this has anything to do with the Guthixian Edicts?

steps.text:
Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer.
  • Easy path recommended.

actions.text: You still want to go to Burgh de Rott?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.

steps.text: Complete the run of Temple Trekking.

Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer.
  • If the Mercenary Adventurer isn't here, skip this step.

steps.title: The Myreque's task
steps.text: Climb down the trapdoor inside the pub in Burgh de Rott.

actions.text: Do you have a job for me?

steps.text: Board the boat to Meiyerditch south-east of Burgh de Rott.

actions.text: Send me to the mines! (Do a bit of menial work)

steps.text: Use the ore on a minecart

actions.text: Yes, I'll place it all in the cart.

steps.text: Climb the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb down the stairs at the end of the path.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.

actions.text: Can I help in some way?

steps.title: In search of the weapon
steps.text: Talk to Andiess Juip or Kael Forshaw.

actions.text: Hi there, I was wondering if I could ask some questions?

steps.warning: Need the page number from the previous step.

steps.text: Climb down the ladder at the end of the path.
Enter the home at the end of the path.
Climb the ladder at the end of the path.
Use the coal on the furnace.
Climb down the wooden beam at the end of the path.
Climb the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb down the stairs at the end of the path.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.
Take 2 silver and 2 mithril bars from the barrel on the northern wall.
Take a silver sickle (b) from the shelf.
Search the crate to the south.
Add the chain link mould to your tool belt.
Climb down the ladder at the end of the path.
Enter the home at the end of the path.
Climb down the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb down the wooden beam at the end of the path.
Climb the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb down the stairs at the end of the path.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.

actions.text: How about using this as the head for the flail?

steps.text: Use a silver sickle (b) on Flaygian.

actions.text: How about using this as the head for the flail?

steps.text: Climb down the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb down the staircase at the end of the path.

actions.text: Is there anything I can do?

steps.text: Search the door to the south. Use the saw.
Follow the path to the large chamber where the strange stones are.
Search the corpse next to the rocks.
Search the strange stones in the northern part of the cavern.
Defend against the vyrewatches. You can't damage them.
Use an emerald on a silver sickle (b).
Cast Lvl-2 Enchant spell on the silver sickle emerald (b).
Use the chain on enchanted emerald sickle.
Climb down the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb down the stairs at the end of the path.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.

steps.title: Back to the Columbarium
steps.text: Return to the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott.

actions.text: The Flail of Ivandis kills Vyrewatch!
Veliaf asked me to bring this Vyrewatch corpse to you.

steps.text: Climb down the stairway to the west.
Use the pyre logs on a funeral pyre.
Use the vyre corpse on the funeral pyre.
Take the ornate tomb key from the pedestal.
Use the key on the wall storage unit.

Return to the Burgh de Rott pub basement.
  • It's recommended to do an easy Temple Trek to get back quickly.
